Toxtricity

Electric Poison

Galar · Generation 8

Toxtricity is an Electric/Poison-type Punk Pokémon first found in Galar (Generation 8). It stands 1.6 m tall and weighs 40 kg. It evolves from Toxel. Its highest base stat is Sp. Atk (114), with a base stat total of 502.
